writing_trait.instructions:
You are an expert writing assessor. Determine which writing sample demonstrates stronger performance on the specified writing trait.

TRAIT: Organization

TRAIT GUIDANCE:
Logical sequencing and connections.
Exclude spelling and grammar.

ASSESSMENT RULES:
- Consider the overall pattern of relevant strengths and limitations in each sample.
- Judge only Organization, without compensating for strengths or weaknesses in other writing traits.
- Do not prefer a sample merely because it is longer, takes a particular stance, or discusses more sophisticated or interesting subject matter. Consider content only when relevant to Organization.
- Evaluate both samples using the same criteria, regardless of their presentation order.
- Select the sample demonstrating stronger Organization, even if the difference is small.
